name: Moonsorrow
description: '''Moonsorrow''' is a Finnish [[pagan metal]] band formed in [[Helsinki]] in 1995. The band incorporates [[black metal]] and [[folk metal]] into their sound.  The band call their sound "epic heathen metal" and distance themselves from "[[Viking metal]]" and other folk metal bands, emphasising that their [[Neopaganism|pagan]] and [[spirituality|spiritual]] music is throught-provoking rather than happy or danceable. The band members' pagan beliefs vary, but they draw on paganism for inspiration.
